baseline_ci_scope: Ubuntu and Windows workflow associated with the pinned main revision; not proof for later changes.

claims.claim: Closed core object contracts reject tested unknown/forbidden fields.
claims.scope: Five core schemas and the JavaScript reference runtime.

evidence.test: request validation rejects unknown and secret-bearing fields

claims.limits: Finite fixtures do not establish universal validation correctness or companion conformance.
claims.next_evidence: Rerun candidate contracts and independent implementations.

claims.claim: The local policy proof exercises four decision states and approval binding.
claims.scope: Synthetic reference/local-core policy profiles.

evidence.test: policy engine deterministically emits allow, reduce, approval, and deny states
approval requires explicit authentication and exact request and policy digest binding

claims.limits: An authenticated approval input is not a production consent UI or identity service.
claims.next_evidence: Specify portable policy and approval semantics for independent implementation.

claims.claim: The local bundle profile signs canonical JSON with Ed25519 and rejects tested tampering.
claims.scope: Local experimental envelope, synthetic keys and listed canonicalization cases.

evidence.test: Ed25519 verification rejects tampering, wrong keys, and malformed signatures
Ed25519 Unicode signatures interoperate with independent canonical bytes

claims.limits: Public-key verification does not prove issuer trust, managed key custody, all RFC edge cases or outside review. Legacy HMAC reading is opt-in.
claims.next_evidence: Publish precise signing/canonicalization contracts and cross-implementation vectors.

claims.claim: Recipients reject tested wrong-recipient, expiry, revocation and replay cases.
claims.scope: Trusted single-user local consumer and receipt-log boundary.

evidence.test: local agent rejects wrong-recipient, expired, and revoked bundles
local agent enforces durable single-use replay across receipt-log reopen

claims.limits: Cannot enforce deletion or prevent misuse by a compromised recipient after disclosure. Handler code and the revocation source are trusted.
claims.next_evidence: Add independent negative tests and deployment-specific identity/revocation evidence.

claims.claim: Receipt chains detect tested tampering and migrate earlier anchors.
claims.scope: Local append-only log, signed sidecar and same-filesystem locking.

evidence.test: version-1 HMAC logs verify read-only, migrate on open, and keep replay history
authenticated anchor detects rollback, rewrite, and unanchored suffixes

claims.limits: Coordinated rollback of log and sidecar remains possible. A receipt attests to reported operations, not complete behavioral correctness.
claims.next_evidence: Test protected external checkpoints before claiming stronger rollback resistance.

claims.claim: The vault encrypts persisted test data and the files adapter enforces tested root boundaries.
claims.scope: One experimental local vault and UTF-8 files adapter.

evidence.test: vault uses versioned AES-256-GCM envelopes and exposes no plaintext at rest
files adapter rejects outside-root, oversized, invalid UTF-8, and symlink paths

claims.limits: No production key custody, tenant isolation or hostile-process protection is established.
claims.next_evidence: Specify and assess actual production custody and process boundaries separately.

claims.claim: The consumer produces pending memory proposals without a direct commit API.
claims.scope: Synthetic local-core/reference proposal-only writeback.

evidence.test: memory writeback remains a receipted pending proposal with no commit API

claims.limits: This does not implement a human review interface or an approved-commit workflow.
claims.next_evidence: Review and test a separate commit workflow and human comprehension before claiming it exists.

claims.claim: Four hash-bound core vector sets and a synthetic local demo are executable.
claims.scope: Core v0.2 manifest and repository-local JavaScript runner.

evidence.test: manifest binds every synthetic vector by content and coverage
synthetic demo runs end to end and emits only its minimized summary

claims.limits: The baseline runner imports repository modules. Six fixtures and CL-Pass prose oracles are not six executable vector sets or a standalone kit.
claims.next_evidence: Version an implementation-neutral kit and report actual case and set totals.

claims.claim: The repository contains documentation routes and checks source/asset contracts.
claims.scope: site/context-layer source and site/vercel.json.
claims.limits: Source assertions do not verify current production deployment, every browser viewport or human usability.
claims.next_evidence: Check rendered preview and production bytes at the exact deployment revision.

claims.claim: Package metadata and core/companion wire identifiers are separate.
claims.scope: Package 0.2.0-draft.2; core context-layer/0.2-draft; companion context-layer/0.3-draft.
claims.limits: A version string does not establish compatibility, an issued tag or release readiness.
claims.next_evidence: Apply RELEASE.md exact-candidate gates and explicit publication approval.

claims.claim: CL-Pass schemas and behavioral oracles describe a separate experimental proposal.
claims.scope: context-layer/0.3-draft companions.
claims.limits: Schema-valid examples do not demonstrate T01–T10 behavior or a live issuer.
claims.next_evidence: Implement and execute every claimed companion behavior before upgrading status.

claims.claim: Broader source, organization, federation, semantic proxy and discovery profiles are design targets.
claims.scope: Implementation guide, architecture and essay, including source/site mirrors.
claims.limits: Diagrams and recipes do not prove extraction, semantic redaction, mobile UI, recovery or production adapters exist.
claims.next_evidence: Link a concrete implementation, supported profile and negative tests for each capability.

claims.claim: MCP and A2A mappings are informative proposals at the pinned baseline.
claims.scope: Guide agent profiles and recipes; synthetic website examples.
claims.limits: A local-agent consumer or HTML simulation is not an actual MCP/A2A exchange, production integration or vendor endorsement.
claims.next_evidence: Record real protocol-level exchange, pinned protocol version, negative tests and fresh-clone timing.

claims.claim: The Nostr profile is unsubmitted and event kinds remain unassigned.
claims.scope: Experimental discussion draft only.
claims.limits: No accepted NIP, tested relay interoperability or deployed minimum-reveal service is established.
claims.next_evidence: Obtain implementation and relay evidence; submission requires a separate decision.

claims.claim: Outside implementation and adoption are not established by baseline artifacts.
claims.scope: All code and demonstrations in the pinned repository snapshot.
claims.limits: Project-produced second-language or clean-room code can test implementability without proving outside ownership or adoption.
claims.next_evidence: Apply GOALS.md G-IMPLEMENT and G-ADOPT with consenting outside project-owner confirmation.

claims.claim: Independent security review and certification are not established.
claims.scope: Protocol, cryptography, local runtime and site.
claims.limits: Regression tests and disclosure instructions are not an outside audit, security score or certification.
claims.next_evidence: Record real independent review scope and finding dispositions; keep unsupported assurances absent.

claims.claim: Generated/fuzz coverage beyond deterministic regressions is not established at baseline.
claims.scope: Bundle/receipt parsing, replay and revocation properties.
claims.limits: Named negative examples are not a measured fuzz campaign.
claims.next_evidence: Link reproducible seeds, command, corpus, budget and failures for a generated/property suite.

claims.claim: Human comprehension, explain-back and external user outcomes are unmeasured.
claims.scope: README, site and protocol documentation.
claims.limits: Automated readability metrics and model reviews cannot establish what actual people understood.
claims.next_evidence: Record consented, anonymized human method/results separately from reading scores.

claims.claim: Immutable schema publication and standalone external conformance are unverified at baseline.
claims.scope: Core and companion schema IDs and deployment paths.
claims.limits: An $id, local route or alias does not prove a stable live URL or successful standalone installation.
claims.next_evidence: Resolve each versioned URL, compare expected bytes/hashes and test the packaged runner outside the checkout.

claims.claim: Private disclosure has a documented GitHub destination; form availability requires an authenticated check.
claims.scope: Repository security policy and issue routing.
claims.limits: Public read on 2026-10-09 reached GitHub login only. This verifies the destination route, not an eligible reporter submission. No fallback contact is invented.
claims.next_evidence: Verify the authenticated private form before release; do not post exploit details publicly if unavailable.
